_about: GS1 company prefixes (the first six digits of a UPC-A, after the leading 0 of an EAN-13) for makers whose containers sold in NL are all ready-to-serve NON-ALCOHOLIC drinks. Because every such container up to 5 L refunds 5¢ whatever it is made of, the maker alone decides the answer. Derived 2026-09-13 from the product list (every row under each prefix was a non-alcoholic drink, six or more rows) and checked against what each company sells in Canada. A prefix is only used when the exact barcode is not in the list. Anything that could be milk, a plant milk, or a nutrition drink must NOT be listed here.

069000.examples: Pepsi, 7UP, Mountain Dew, bubly, Gatorade, Aquafina, Brisk, Rockstar

067000.examples: Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, Sprite, Fanta, Dasani, Powerade, Fresca

049000.examples: Coke, Sprite, Fanta, Powerade, smartwater, vitaminwater

012000.examples: Pepsi, Mountain Dew, bubly, Gatorade, Aquafina

062000.maker: Canada Dry Mott's / Keurig Dr Pepper Canada
062000.examples: Canada Dry, Schweppes, Mott's Clamato, Crush, Dr Pepper

060383.examples: PC pop, no name water and juice
060383.note: Loblaw's prefix also covers PC milk and PC oat beverages, so this entry is DISABLED; kept here so nobody re-adds it.

096619.examples: Kirkland water, juice, but also milk, almond milk, formula
096619.note: Mixed maker: milk and formula share the prefix. DISABLED; Kirkland items must be in the list by exact barcode or go through the label photo.
